events.title: Aero unification and legacy AERO/VELO emissions cutoff announced
events.description: The forthcoming Aero transition involves Aerodrome and Velodrome. Extra Finance announced that legacy AERO and VELO incentive emissions are scheduled to end on 2026-10-22 at 00:00 UTC and that borrowing for new Extra Finance leveraged farming positions would pause on 2026-10-14 at 08:00 UTC. The announcement does not establish that Aerodrome has ceased exchange operations or completed migration.
events.notes: This is an announcement/transition milestone, not a completed merger, shutdown or token conversion. Recheck status after the announced October 22 cutoff.
